{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print("Unique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Unique assay_batch:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("Sample_seq max:", df['sample_seq'].max())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nDuplicate patient_id rows:")
duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('patient_id')
print(duplicates[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm', 'severity', 'biomarker_baseline', 'responded']])"}
